author: Michael Larabel
description: Valve released tonight a new Steam client beta that includes some notable improvements for Linux users...
title: Steam Beta Now Defaults Non-Steam Windows Binaries To Using Proton

author: Michael Larabel
description: Back in February we featured LiteBox as a new Microsoft open-source project building out a Rust-based sandboxing Library OS. LiteBox leverages Linux virtualization security features and Rust language inherent benefits to provide the ability for sandboxing Linux apps on Linux, Linux programs on Windows, and other security-oriented deployments. Out today is the first tagged release of LiteBox for this open-source library operating system...
title: Microsoft Issues First Release Of Their LiteBox Sandboxing Library OS

author: Michael Larabel
description: FEX 2610 released today as the newest monthly release of this open-source emulator for running x86_64 games/apps on AArch64 for ARM64 Linux systems, including most notably by Valve's Steam Frame headset...
title: FEX 2610 Released With Handling For AVX-VNNI, Disk Cache Improvements

author: Michael Larabel
description: When it comes to Linux pre-loaded laptops, I have looked at hardware from most of these vendors over the past 22+ years of Phoronix. One vendor I haven't had the chance to personally test until now is the UK-based Star Labs. That changed recently and over the past few weeks I have been testing out their new StarFighter laptop that offers great Linux support and comes pre-loaded with Coreboot and streamlined firmware updates via LVFS. For those after a high-end mobile workstation, the Star Labs StarFighter offers a lot of performance potential while being open-source friendly and with Coreboot in tow.
title: Star Labs StarFighter Ultra: A Modern High-End Linux Laptop With Coreboot

author: Michael Larabel
description: NVIDIA today released their 615.78.08 Linux driver build with a useful improvement for gamers using Steam Play (Proton) with Direct3D 12 games via VKD3D-Proton along with a variety of other fixes...
title: NVIDIA 615.78.08 Linux Driver Adds VK_NV_low_latency2 r3 For Improved VKD3D-Proton

author: Michael Larabel
description: Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 "Hawi" SoC features the Qualcomm Page Compression Engine "QPaCE" hardware accelerator. Linux patches posted recently provide a QPaCE driver for accelerating page compression and decompression for the ZRAM block device...
title: Qualcomm Posts QPaCE Linux Driver Code For Faster ZRAM On Newest SoCs

author: Michael Larabel
description: Huawei engineers are experimenting with a new file-system called XMFS. XMFS was presented this week at LPC 2026 in Czechia as a file-system for modern Linux servers with CXL 3.0 or Huawei United Bus connectivity...
title: XMFS: Experimental File-System Being Worked On By Huawei For Modern Linux Servers

author: Michael Larabel
description: Following the Windows Subsystem for Linux 3.0.2 release with support for running WSL2 now on very large servers and also experimental sparse VHD storage support, Microsoft has now released a new version of the WSL2 Linux kernel as their downstream kernel configuration tailored for WSL2 usage...
title: Microsoft Updates Its WSL2 Linux Kernel With DXGKRNL Improvement, More Features Enabled

author: Michael Larabel
description: One of the AMD Zen 6 CPU features that hasn't been talked about too widely beyond appearing in a public AMD tech doc is the IBS Memory Profiler. This week in Prague at LPC 2026 an AMD engineer talked up Zen 6's IBS Memory Profiler and its benefits for hot page detection and promotion on Linux systems...
title: AMD Engineer Talks Up New IBS Memory Profiler Feature Found On Zen 6
